import copy
def diff():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    prev = previous_frame.segmentation
    def keyset(s):
        return {(n['color'], n['pixels'], tuple(map(tuple,n['boundary']))) for n in s['nodes']}
    cur, pre = keyset(seg), keyset(prev)
    ap = [c for c in cur-pre]; di = [c for c in pre-cur]
    # ignore the top bar (row 1) changes
    ap = [c for c in ap if c[2] and c[2][0][0]!=1]
    di = [c for c in di if c[2] and c[2][0][0]!=1]
    return ap, di

for label,(r,c) in {"glyph1":(44,21),"panel":(45,25),"bar":(1,30)}.items():
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    ap, di = diff()
    print(label, "APPEARED:", ap, "DISAPPEARED:", di, "res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','game_over','done')})
    if ap or di:
        break
